title: Bullet Electra 350
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Royal Enfield Bullet Electra 350 is engineered for relaxed boulevard cruising backed by muscular roll-on passing power. At its heart lies a 350cc powertrain delivering 40 HP and 35 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 165 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 13.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
